changelog:
Sales-manager 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduced a comprehensive sales team management skill focused on goal management, process oversight, and incentive scheme design.
- Provides structured systems for setting and tracking sales targets (daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual).
- Includes profit-oriented and partner-based incentive schemes to address traditional commission pitfalls.
- Covers end-to-end processes: recruitment workflow, onboarding, daily reporting, customer follow-up, performance review, and offboarding/handover procedures.
- Designed practical scenarios and interview guides for recruitment and performance supervision.
- Supports integration with Feishu spreadsheets for dashboards, follow-up tracking, commission calculations, and recruitment monitoring.
summary: 销售团队全流程管理技能。适用于：1) 设定和跟踪销售目标（日/周/月/季度/年） 2) 过程管理（每日打卡、客户跟进监督、复盘） 3) 提成与激励方案设计（利润导向+合伙人机制） 4) 招聘流程管理 5) 离职交接管理。侧重目标管理和过程管理。
